Annex This!
by Lenlyvit
Mon, 13 Oct 2025

This post comes courtesy of Beta Tester Lenlyvit.

Tired of always salting the earth of your vanquished foes, when instead you could be marching them off to work for you? Longing to build an empire upon which the servers will never set? We have just the feature for you, and it's called Annexation. Annexation is a fresh new tool in the arsenal of budding tyrants that allows one Frontier region to completely absorb the nations of another Frontier after a set period of time, but first you must gain the most powerful position within the region: World Assembly Delegate.

Intended to add another dynamic layer to Frontier gameplay, Annexation is meant to encourage politicking between Frontier regions. Want a Frontier of your own, but tired of waiting for the population to increase slowly? Then conquer another Frontier and annex its entire population, forcibly relocating every resident nation to yours! Who cares if they don't all agree with the results of being moved to your region? It's your empire, you can rule how you want!

Annexation is only available to Frontiers, and only fellow Frontier regions can be targeted.

Have any questions? Feel free to join the discussion for this update found in the Technical Forum![/quote]
